issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing GPU, invalid input paths, or malformed PDFs.
The instructions assume a Unix-like shell and Docker, limiting compatibility with Windows or non-Docker environments.

scenarios.name: convert-scanned-pdf-to-markdown
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required chandra CLI command with method hf and no-images, specifies input PDF and output directory, and indicates a .md file will be produced, whereas Response A does not use chandra at all.

scenarios.name: extract-invoice-tables-into-csv
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers almost all rubric items except the exact output filename, while Response B does not meet any of the specified requirements.

scenarios.name: ocr-images-with-headers-vllm
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers some steps and output details but omits the explicit server start command and the --batch-size flag, while Response B provides no content.
